I would not extend this box. I would leave its date unchanged, mark the record reviewed, and release it on today’s outbound manifest with the rest of the batch.

No written duty-manager permission is registered, and the 9 October note is only a pending request. Under OPS-14 that is not permission, a collection booking does not take a box off the manifest, and operators do not grant discretionary extensions. The manager has already directed no discretionary extensions this cycle and an on-time release of the full batch. The next approval sitting is tomorrow, after the 13:30 release deadline, and permission given later would not cover a change made today. Holding the manifest would stop the whole dispatch and record the shift as incomplete, which the same instruction rules out.
